From 282e5f8fe907dc3f2fbf9f2103b0e62ffc3a68a5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Florian Westphal <fw@strlen.de>
Date: Wed, 1 Jun 2022 10:47:35 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] netfilter: nat: really support inet nat without l3 address

When no l3 address is given, priv->family is set to NFPROTO_INET and
the evaluation function isn't called.

Call it too so l4-only rewrite can work.
Also add a test case for this.

Fixes: a33f387ecd5aa ("netfilter: nft_nat: allow to specify layer 4 protocol NAT only")
Reported-by: Yi Chen <yiche@redhat.com>
Signed-off-by: Florian Westphal <fw@strlen.de>
Signed-off-by: Pablo Neira Ayuso <pablo@netfilter.org>

diff --git a/net/netfilter/nft_nat.c b/net/netfilter/nft_nat.c
index 4394df4bc99b..e5fd6995e4bf 100644
--- a/net/netfilter/nft_nat.c
+++ b/net/netfilter/nft_nat.c
@@ -335,7 +335,8 @@ static void nft_nat_inet_eval(const struct nft_expr *expr,
 {
 	const struct nft_nat *priv = nft_expr_priv(expr);
 
-	if (priv->family == nft_pf(pkt))
+	if (priv->family == nft_pf(pkt) ||
+	    priv->family == NFPROTO_INET)
 		nft_nat_eval(expr, regs, pkt);
 }
 

diff --git a/tools/testing/selftests/netfilter/nft_nat.sh b/tools/testing/selftests/netfilter/nft_nat.sh
index eb8543b9a5c4..924ecb3f1f73 100755
--- a/tools/testing/selftests/netfilter/nft_nat.sh
+++ b/tools/testing/selftests/netfilter/nft_nat.sh
@@ -374,6 +374,45 @@ EOF
 	return $lret
 }
 
+test_local_dnat_portonly()
+{
+	local family=$1
+	local daddr=$2
+	local lret=0
+	local sr_s
+	local sr_r
+
+ip netns exec "$ns0" nft -f /dev/stdin <<EOF
+table $family nat {
+	chain output {
+		type nat hook output priority 0; policy accept;
+		meta l4proto tcp dnat to :2000
+
+	}
+}
+EOF
+	if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
+		if [ $family = "inet" ];then
+			echo "SKIP: inet port test"
+			test_inet_nat=false
+			return
+		fi
+		echo "SKIP: Could not add $family dnat hook"
+		return
+	fi
+
+	echo SERVER-$family | ip netns exec "$ns1" timeout 5 socat -u STDIN TCP-LISTEN:2000 &
+	sc_s=$!
+
+	result=$(ip netns exec "$ns0" timeout 1 socat TCP:$daddr:2000 STDOUT)
+
+	if [ "$result" = "SERVER-inet" ];then
+		echo "PASS: inet port rewrite without l3 address"
+	else
+		echo "ERROR: inet port rewrite"
+		ret=1
+	fi
+}
 
 test_masquerade6()
 {
@@ -1148,6 +1187,10 @@ fi
 reset_counters
 test_local_dnat ip
 test_local_dnat6 ip6
+
+reset_counters
+test_local_dnat_portonly inet 10.0.1.99
+
 reset_counters
 $test_inet_nat && test_local_dnat inet
 $test_inet_nat && test_local_dnat6 inet
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `net/netfilter/nft_nat.c`**
   - The evaluation function `nft_nat_inet_eval` was modified to include an additional condition in the if statement. It now checks if `priv->family` is either equal to `nft_pf(pkt)` or `NFPROTO_INET`. This change allows the function to call `nft_nat_eval` even when the layer 3 (L3) address is not provided, enabling layer 4 (L4) only NAT rewrites to function correctly.

2. **File: `tools/testing/selftests/netfilter/nft_nat.sh`**
   - A new test function `test_local_dnat_portonly` was added to verify the functionality of L4-only NAT rewrites without an L3 address. This function sets up a NAT table and chain, performs a DNAT operation, and checks if the port rewrite works as expected.
   - The new test function is invoked in the test sequence, specifically for the `inet` family, to ensure that the changes made in the NAT evaluation logic are functioning correctly.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `nft_nat.c` directly supports the new test case added in `nft_nat.sh`. By allowing the NAT evaluation function to be called without an L3 address, the patch ensures that the functionality being tested (L4-only NAT) is operational. The test case serves to validate the correctness of the changes made in the NAT evaluation logic, confirming that the system can handle NAT operations even when only L4 information is available. This relationship highlights the importance of testing in the development process, ensuring that new features or fixes work as intended.
